why: Searches found only the same two known Wieferich primes (1093, 3511), pre-2024 conditional results (Silverman, Graves-Murty under abc-conjecture), and unrelated generalizations to number fields/function fields (2025 arXiv papers) that change a different, analogous question rather than the base-2 infinitude question.
